title: Your agents. One workspace.
style: Original illustrated motion graphics. Existing graphite/cream, lilac/green logo accents, warm amber connectors. System sans, large headlines, rounded cards, restrained orbital motion, cubic interpolation, drawn dependency paths, layered lateral transitions. No voice, music, live UI or performance claims.

limits: Conceptual illustration, not a recording of agents working. Worktrees isolate git changes, not processes. Snapshot branches are explicit saved context, not native provider session forks. Desktop control is macOS only; platform and provider capabilities vary. See the feature guide for availability. No usage or performance figures are shown.
